Would any of these work for you next week?

Or you can pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30

If you’ll have a technical lead or procurement on the call, let me know and I’ll include Marcus (our AE) and make sure the demo covers those areas. I’ve attached a short demo brief that outlines what we’ll cover.

- 5 min intros + goals
- 10 min demo: Hosted API and Dedicated modes (latency/cost examples)
